title: The adult human
note: SANDBOX: the engine's research numbers (the movement design, grounded, as KCD) until the rules package's curves replace them. Metres, seconds, m/s, m/s^2, degrees. JumpHeight is the metres the feet rise (the rules' JumpImpulseBudget is the upward speed that lifts them so high); FallTolerance is the impact speed taken unharmed (8 m/s: a drop of about 3.3 m). The masquerade holds every body to these numbers. SafeFall: a walk stops at an edge whose drop is more than this; 1.5 (the human's multiplier) x 1.9 m (the larger of its jump, 0.5 m, and its MantleMax, 1.9 m) = 2.85 m. StartStopHalfLife: the half-life of the starts and stops on the ground, a critically damped spring (0.2 s: the models repository's proposal, 0.15-0.25; 0 would be the earlier build's fixed ramp of AccelerationCapacity and BrakingDeceleration, which the air still uses).
